notes: Mode-A provenance-caution canaries (Close-the-Loops L2). Each case puts a CONTESTED figure (low scored confidence and/or a cross-source ⚠ disagreement, in the [conf …; ⚠ …] tag ask.grounding._fact_item now appends) into the evidence the answer model reads, and asserts the answer FLAGS / DISCOUNTS it rather than stating it as settled fact. No expected output — the invariant is graded by code (the answer must surface a caution signal). The default runner streams the real build_evidence_block prompt through the live transport; tests inject a fake runner so the suite never spends. Keep the set small (live runs cost model spend). evidence_text mirrors _fact_item's output verbatim so the case stays faithful to production. The ACME cases added in this lane are explicitly synthetic contract fixtures, not reported company facts.
